items.title: Sections of the constant sheaf attached to a flat module over a coherent ring are flat
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-modules.tex (Modules on Sites)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a coherent ring and a flat module M, the sections of the constant sheaf attached to M over any object of the site form a flat module. The proof uses the criterion that flatness may be checked on finitely generated ideals: for such an ideal I the map M tensor I -> M is injective by flatness of M, and since coherence makes I finitely presented, the tensor product of the constant sheaves computes the constant sheaf of the tensor product, so the induced map of constant sheaves is injective, which gives the required injectivity after taking sections (proof lines 8466-8475). H2: the transfer between the module-level and sheaf-level tensor products using finite presentation is the substance.
